chapter: Rhythm Club, studio dates and the 1930s big bands
title: Red Allen's Vocalion dates and sidemen
summary: Red Allen's sessions used no written music; Welburn lists titles and sidemen like Pete Clark, Clyde Hart, Tab Smith and Cozy Cole.
